description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential opportunity offers a chance to make a significant impact on patient care and facility success. The ideal candidate will be a visionary leader with a passion for excellence in long-term care.

In this pivotal role, you will oversee all aspects of facility management, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. You will be responsible for strategic planning, financial management, and maintaining high-quality care standards. This is an urgent opening for a dedicated professional ready to take on a challenging yet rewarding leadership position.
requirements: Active Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility
Strong leadership and operational management skills
In-depth knowledge of state and federal regulations for long-term care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $145,000, commensurate with experience.
